name: CIM Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc.
summary: CIM Real Estate Finance Trust (CMFT) operates as a publicly accessible, yet non-exchange-traded, corporate entity. It has successfully elected and continues to meet the necessary qualifications to be taxed as a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT). CMFT's asset base is diversified, comprising both net lease and multi-tenant retail properties, in addition to a portfolio of real estate-backed loans and various other credit-related financial instruments. Entities affiliated with CIM are responsible for the management and strategic oversight of CMFT.
